question_full:

Options: A: If you want to get a towel, you should walk forward to the right. B: If you want to go to the toilet, you should turn right and then right again. C: If you want to wash your hands, you should walk forward to the left. D: If you want to go to the toilet, you should turn right and then left.
choices: A. If you want to get a towel, you should walk forward to the right.
B. If you want to go to the toilet, you should turn right and then right again.
C. If you want to wash your hands, you should walk forward to the left.
D. If you want to go to the toilet, you should turn right and then left.
